targetBrief:
Create ONE ULTRA-REALISTIC edited EXPLAINER VIDEO storyboard. Portrait overall canvas with an exact 2x2 grid of FOUR COMPLETE INDEPENDENT portrait frames. High resolution. No outside title, margins or gutters. Each quadrant is a different real camera shot of the SAME fictional person with the SAME clothes, place and objects. It must show an ambitious PROFESSIONALLY COMPOSITED SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO with graphics BEING BUILT IN THE REAL SCENE AS THE PERSON SPEAKS AND ACTS. This is NOT a person explaining next to a ready-made static diagram or panel. Make the intended layering and transformations plainly visible in the frames.

CORE DEPTH: original believable environment / explanatory element BEHIND body or an observed hand / person or hands / explanatory FOREGROUND. Use precise occlusion, perspective, scale, grounded soft shadows and contact when applicable: a fingertip partly hides a model, a line goes BEHIND the forearm then emerges IN FRONT, the person crosses a developing diagram, layers assemble or separate as the explanation changes. These are functional relationships, not a permanent aura or decorative floating icons. Information must GROW, TRANSFORM, CONNECT or REVEAL across the four frames, never be the identical finished graphic in every frame. Keep faces, meaningful hands and caption area clear. Different shots may let the person yield to a full-screen demonstration, POV, macro or small inset.

QUALITY: like professionally shot footage of real adults at actual everyday businesses. Unretouched natural skin texture, realistic hair, eyes, modest natural teeth, relaxed mouth, correct hands, plausible real wardrobe and accessories. All people are adults. No plastic faces, mannequin smiles, generic AI luxury interiors, game HUD, neon sci-fi hologram, flat vector people or fantasy workplace. Editorial/luxury/playful styles should remain tactile and believable; rich through intentional photography, design and material, not excessive saturation. Camera motion in the storyboard must have a reason in the explanation. Soft light accents only at the important event, surface reflections and light film texture; a social-media finish, not a heavy cinema LUT.

DIVERSITY AND EXPLANATION: Do not reduce the content to a few callout tags. Make the main explanatory construction substantial, dimensional and understandable, with components being assembled, separated, connected or transformed. It can use a model, growing diagram, environment-linked interface, pathway, layered objects, negative-space typography or a clearly motivated visual metaphor. Vary the graphic material by purpose. No default rounded rectangular label pills or frosted-glass caption boxes, no permanent side panel. Short clean type may sit directly in the physical scene with precise lines, appropriate perspective and occlusion. Different styles must not share a universal speaking portrait / tags / smiling summary layout.

Typography is an editable design reference: sophisticated, modern, elegant and legible at phone size. VERY SHORT Portuguese labels (roughly one to three words), much of the frame can be text-free. NO how-to question headline, NO generic talking-head introduction, NO recurring yellow underline, NO brush-highlight text template, NO checkmark list, NO mandatory final front-facing summary portrait. Do not print the internal instructions or four scene labels. Use the specific narrative structure and typography direction. No real brands, logos, prescription, diagnosis, savings, guaranteed results, made-up amounts, percentages or measurements. Scientific/technical/miniature or location model is an identified 'Simulação', not proof of actual microscopy, exact real geometry, a visit or data.

All important content stays fully inside its own quadrant with safe breathing space; do not crop heads, fingers, graphics or words at a grid boundary. These are STATIC FICTIONAL REFERENCE FRAMES for the intended edit, not produced animation or tracking proof.
COMMERCIAL STYLE: A luz desenha o espaço; USE: explicar luz natural e posição solar de um apartamento.
REAL ENVIRONMENT: a lived-in high-end apartment with timber floor, linen curtains and a realistic city outlook.
PERSON: fictional Brazilian woman 31, olive skin, curly shoulder-length hair, small elegant earrings. CLOTHES: refined ecru blouse with modern tailored dark trousers, discreet accessories.
NARRATIVE: alto padrão · documented sun path. TYPOGRAPHY: Serifada editorial contemporânea com sans humanista para dados; alinhamento preciso, amplo respiro e uma cor extra do ambiente..
QUADRANT TOP LEFT: CAMERA plano lateral da janela; PERSON POSITION right; COMMERCIAL ACTION A corretora abre a cortina e uma faixa discreta acompanha a luz realmente filmada no piso.; EDITED INFORMATION ACTION A corretora abre a cortina e uma faixa discreta acompanha a luz realmente filmada no piso.. PROPERTY REFERENCE: fictional illustrative property, no fake address, price, distance, registration, dimensions, claimed solar study, yield or eligibility. Models and alternate views are identified Simulação. Do not invent a recognisable real development or brand. High-end means thoughtful architecture, photography, materials and well-dressed professional presentation, not artificial gold CGI luxury. Preserve a consistent plausible property across shots.
